title: [교외행사] VSUES announces the International Online Summer School 2021
contentHtml:
VSUES announces the International Online Summer School 2021.

Course duration: June 28 – July 09, 2021

Application deadline: June 05, 2021

Program language: Russian

The VSUES 2-week Summer School for Russian Language and Culture is now
open for applications! It offers:
- Interactive Russian language classes despite of the students previous
level of the Russian language proficiency
- Russian culture and tradition master-classes with intensive cultural
emersion
- Video stream excursions in Vladivostok

This Summer School provides a truly life-changing experience to students
from all over the world! It’s a great way to boost up your language
skills during the summer holiday and immerse yourself in the Russian
language and culture.

Course information: extracurricular and self-directed study and various
practical field trips.

Credits for the program: 1.5 ECTS
Certificate of Completion will be provided to students who successfully
completed the program with passing grades.


Admission documents:
To apply for a program a student should submit via email:
- a scan of passport page with photo.
- an application form (available on the web site in appendix), typed in,
signed and scanned.
